target_statement: Kernel-formalize the written 'uniform five-layer obstruction' (proofs/chat-6acee928/originals/p196_uniform_five_layer_obstruction.md, section 1, eqs. (1)-(2); written proof only) in a strengthened form: for every natural X of decimal width >= 5 whose outer four pair sums are (q0,q1,q2,q3) with q0 in {10,12,14,16}, q1 = 0, q2 in {0,10,12,14,16}, q3 = 0 (no condition on inner positions), and every positive A and t >= 5, Lychrel196.orbit A t != X. This implies the written statement (which constrains every position). Corollaries: no Lychrel196.orbit 196 t has the written pattern (any t); sharpness: orbit 10000 4 = 80008 has the full written pattern, so 5 cannot be lowered to 4. Route: a four-column version of the all-width prefix projection (Agent113.TwoDigit.tri_step generalized to k=4), backward layer certificates (sizes 20,20,18,17,5, then empty) checked by decide +kernel, exhaustive check of numbers below 1000. No native_decide, no new axioms. NOT claimed: the mixed-digit H_11(D(V)) <= 6 theorem and corollary (5) of the same file.
